verification.method: scripts/verify/colombia.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2100, share, growth, density, land area; second in South America after Brazil; about four and a half times 1950
Net migration negative every year 1950–2015, positive 2016–2026; record 2018; 2010 and 2026 values; near zero by 2050
Fertility 1959 peak, under 2.1 every year from 2009, now; births peak 1994 and 2026
Peak 2050, natural decrease from 2051, 2100 total; median age 2026/2050; urban share 1950/2026/2050
Title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 70 of 70 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name their size group and region; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
